name: Barbed Wire Person "crawler"
author: keyni
description:
*hopeless creature formed from a mass of barbed wire.* It is possible to delete the bundle of barbed wire and be left with a full character. A high amount of barbs is achieved through instancing (in the .blend) and the wire itself is uv-unwrapped so that one shell is equal to one twist. 
• The **.fbx** is UV unwrapped to fit a tileable bloody-metal texture (included). 
•The **.blend** Down to 451,084 verts because the individual barbs are instanced to save memory. (see image below). Includes a procedural material and simple lighting/camera setup. 

![](https://cdnb.artstation.com/p/assets/images/images/030/973/839/large/keynii-untitled.jpg?1602193597)

name: Eyeless Burrower Digging Horror Creature
author: Pigcraft
description:
A blind subterranean burrower creature, a heavy hunched quadruped horror covered in loose folded pinkish-grey hairless hide, with no eyes at all above a wrinkled twitching snout ringed with fleshy feelers and a lipless mouth of flat grinding teeth. Enormously overdeveloped shoulders drive two pairs of long curved digging claws, and the model is posed neutrally with all four limbs evenly grounded and the broad splayed claw-feet clearly visible, making it well suited for rigging and animation. The asset was generated with the help of AI and finished for game use, with realistic loose hide and keratin claw textures. A strong fit for dark fantasy, underground dungeon crawlers, horror games, cinematic renders and VR scenes. Delivered as a standalone creature without ground or environment.
